narrative.intro: Honeywell Federal Manufacturing and Technologies has $2.1B in federal contract obligations for FY2026 to date, recorded as a single award with an average award size of $2.1B. Honeywell Federal Manufacturing and Technologies obligations are up 0.3% year over year. Honeywell Federal Manufacturing and Technologies obligations track at the same nominal level as FY25, both showing $2.1B, after a range of activity between $1.7B and $2B in FY21 through FY24. Honeywell Federal Manufacturing and Technologies current-year totals are partial, fiscal year to date, and the page notes that listed award-value figures in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables are total contract values rather than obligations. Honeywell Federal Manufacturing and Technologies has had one counted award in the current period, which sets the average award size equal to the total obligations figure. Honeywell Federal Manufacturing and Technologies historical obligations show a step up from $1.7B in FY21 to $2B in FY22, then a slight pullback and stabilization before returning to $2.1B in FY25 and FY26.

sections.heading: What changed in obligations year over year?
sections.body: Honeywell Federal Manufacturing and Technologies obligations are up 0.3% year over year. Honeywell Federal Manufacturing and Technologies moved from $2.1B in FY25 to $2.1B in FY26 with the reported percent change of up 0.3%. Honeywell Federal Manufacturing and Technologies shows this small increase while maintaining the same nominal dollar total across the two most recent fiscal years.

sections.heading: How does FY2026 compare to prior fiscal years?
sections.body: Honeywell Federal Manufacturing and Technologies has $2.1B in FY26 obligations, equal to FY25 and higher than FY23 and FY24, which each show $1.8B. Honeywell Federal Manufacturing and Technologies obligations were lower in FY21 at $1.7B and peaked at $2B in FY22 before returning to the $1.8B and $2.1B range in later years.
